documents.title: Session Summaries
documents.description: Dated .docx session summaries (Naya_Summary_YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM.docx).

documents.title: Main Server
documents.description: Flask server on port 8002. ask_naya() turn pipeline, _llm_call() chain, _try_nexus_synthesize(), Telegram long-poll, peer-bridge webhook, FileHQ auto-start. Loads every Naya module optionally (graceful if missing).

documents.title: DB Redirect Shim
documents.description: Patches maia_db.DB_FILE to C:\APPS\NAYA\naya.db then re-exports all maia_db symbols; adds save_message()/get_history() overrides. Must import before any maia_* module.

documents.title: LLM Intent Extractor
documents.description: LLM-first structured intent extraction with the ~25-action schema (ACTIONS) and the classifier system prompt. PRIMARY router.

documents.title: Action Router
documents.description: dispatch() / dispatch_action() map intents to permission-gated handlers; compound chain_action support; one handler set for chat, Telegram and the File Manager.

documents.title: Legacy Intent Router
documents.description: Keyword/regex router used only as a fallback when LLM intent extraction fails.

documents.title: Gradio Console
documents.description: Gradio UI on port 7861 — Chat, File Manager, Naya Brain, Settings, Logs tabs (Knowledge Base tab commented out).

documents.title: Scanner
documents.description: SHA-256 exact-duplicate scanner (4-phase) + difflib fuzzy-name scanner + USB cross-reference; background, cancellable; writes naya_brain.db.

documents.title: Advisor
documents.description: analyze_storage() + cleanup plan create/approve/execute; recycle-bin-first via send2trash; FileHQ index queries for dupes and old-large files.

documents.title: Memory
documents.description: folder_insight() (read-only FileHQ index, 24h cache), capture_intent(), reminder_message() for proactive reminders.

documents.title: Executor
documents.description: Phase-3 safe-delete: moves non-keep members to NAYA_TRASH, logs batches, undo_last()/undo_batch(); requires file_delete_approved.

documents.title: Deferral
documents.description: Chat-driven deferral + natural-language scheduling; creates Windows Task Scheduler tasks under the Naya\ prefix.

documents.title: Watcher
documents.description: Disk-space monitor, USB watcher, and off-hours scheduler (APScheduler) started by start_watchers().

documents.title: Reporter
documents.description: Report generation in md/txt/docx/pdf; types space/dupes/actions/deferred/full; saved to C:\APPS\NAYA\REPORTS\.

documents.title: FileHQ Bridge
documents.description: HTTP client to the merged FileHQ engine (port 8200): scan trigger, stats, error sanitisation, pre-flight health check.

documents.title: Control-plane DB
documents.description: Maia-schema database (via the shim): config (93 keys), llm_chain (8 models), conversations (690), subjects (67). ~900 KB.

documents.title: File-intelligence DB
documents.description: Scanner/advisor/memory store: naya_scans (178), naya_similarity_groups (~2.7M), folder insights, intents, operations, drives, settings. ~2.3 GB.

documents.title: Secrets
documents.description: Telegram token, Anthropic + OpenRouter keys, LINE creds. Loaded via python-dotenv at startup. Gitignored.

documents.title: Service Control
documents.description: Start/stop/restart/status menu for QI_NayaBot and QI_NayaGradio.

documents.title: QI Service Registry (Naya)
documents.description: Canonical NSSM entries: QI_NayaBot (8002), QI_NayaGradio (7861), QI_NayaTunnel (Cloudflare, UI demos only).

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Registry (naya)
documents.description: Naya registry entry: status=paused, ports 8002/7861, family_tier=sibling_candidate, Telegram-only, LAN-only, integrates_with filehq/nexus/maia.

documents.title: Project Memory Index
documents.description: Claude's persistent memory index for Naya (+ linked files: naya_build_status, filehq_merger, naya_maia_separation, universal_session_protocol).
